scene black

There’s an awkward transition between Location A and Location B that’s hard to quantify in terms of text, so I have taken this opportunity to flip the transitory black CG upside down so you better understand what I mean.

It doesn’t look much different, sure. But now that you know it’s upside down, I hope you’ll adjust your view of what’s happening to reflect the mildly incorrect nature of what I’m currently telling you.

Think of the sky like a zipline and the powerlines that dot it like smaller, more electrical ziplines. We ascend the nearby poles like trees with our EH-rated safety boots and connect once our hands become fists.

And in the moment where black becomes kcalb, we’re united under the watch of three moons each trying to out-moon the other in a vicious battle royale we should probably sell tickets to, but don’t. Three blocks left.
Joined at my hip is the torso of someone smaller than me as I was born with the gift of always being bigger than how I feel. If I shaved with Occam’s Razor, I’d have no trouble blaming God for this.
But as a man with little talent and even less body hair, I’ve naught to do but spare passing glances down at those who pass me on the way to a family home. Two blocks.
Like ants we are beneath this sky — our death spiral severed and elongated so that we stretch from here to Mars. So we’re still marching endlessly, but at least the scenery changes now.
And oh, how it changes. Rearranges. It’s a tale for all the ages waging war against the pages in a book that’s still unwritten. I’ve been smitten. And the colors have dulled over time.
First red. Then pink. Now, a greyish, pale-ish brown. But even when defiant, I’m a tyrant. And I know that up is good and down is bad so I look to the skies but then, suddenly-
A tugging at my sleeve. Three raps upon my chamber door. But it’s a murder of crows instead of a single raven.
And I’m not sure who to speak to when they’re all cawing at once.
One block.
No blocks.
scene skitwar1
Tamerlane.
: Hello and welcome back to Sakaki-bar-a! And thank you for once again choosing my business as the place you most wanted to end another year of the Dorm Wars.
scene skitwar2
: For those who don’t already know, my name is Sara. And I’ll be the host of your final competition this time.
: When I say “host,” though, I mostly mean I’m just going to explain the rules and how your acts will be judged since this is an acting competition at the end of the day and I can definitely not act.
: Nor does anyone probably want me to since I’m not a member of your class and can not help either side obtain the rights to Sensei’s entire person.
: You look young enough to be a member of the class. I assumed you were Sana’s older sister when I first saw you.
scene skitwar3
: I am pleased to announce that the second floor wins. Thank you to everyone who showed up today. Please buy a lot of the non-alcoholic beer I purchased now that the Dorm Wars is over. Thank you.

: Hey! That ain’t fair! I ain’t even gotten a shot to show off my acting chops yet and you’re ready to just hand a whole friggin’ chicken dinner down to the tall girl?! This is discrimination, I tell ya!
: Fight flattery with flattery. I can’t see it not working, to be honest.
: Yo, Sana’s mom! You look pretty and young and whatever!
scene skitwar4
: The contest is back on and we’re suddenly tied!
: Damn. Foiled again.
: The rules this time are simple and, unlike how it was at the cafe, there will be no caveats at all.
: Each of you will have five minutes to perform either an original scene or an adaptation of a scene from a book or a movie.
: You were all notified yesterday that you’re allowed to use up to two other members from your floor as supporting actors, so I hope you used that time wisely to rehearse!
: Rehearsing is for the weak. A true actor can adapt to any situation, no matter the preparation done beforehand.
: A question, if I may?
scene skitwar5
: Sure! Molly, right?
: Aye. I’m just curious about who’s inside of the dolphin this time as Sana has already made an appearance.
: I thought I knew who it was, but Niki’s still on the way. Which really just makes me question how so many people have access to this one specific dolphin costume.
: Hello. It is I. A dolphin.
scene skitwar6
: Wait a sec, are you tellin’ me you ain’t a whale?
: This whole time, I thought you were a whale.
: Miku...come on.
: This could be problematic, but whatever. We’re rolling with it.
: Why would that ever be problematic?
: And roll you shall. That said, if there are no questions, we can go ahead and clear the stage for the first performance — Miku’s take on a scene from Moby Dick.
: Oh, that’s why it would be problematic.
: I tried to warn her. I really did.
: Well, warn me harder next time! Maki’s probably got a whale costume somewhere that we could have used instead of this one.
: I can’t tell which part of me is stronger right now — the one that hopes you fail as penance for your idiocy or the one that must win at all costs.
: Lies. We both know it’s the winning one, Makoto. Just be thankful I’m the one actin’ and you just have to be a whale.
scene skitwar7
: I have to act too because you apparently gave the whale lines!
: Well, it ain’t exciting if it’s just me talking! Now, hurry up and get your butt to your damn mark thingy!
: Is there some sort of reason you keep looking off to the side instead of directly into my eyes?
: Niki’s going to be showing up soon, Maya. Are you sure you want to be standing next to me when she does?
: Do I look like a kid to you?
: You-
: Don’t actually answer that question. All it will do is further damage your already-declining mental state.
: You know me so well.
scene skitwar8
: Well enough to know you’ve probably already made it through your weird inner-monologue for the night and that the current moment we exist inside is just a bridge to the next one.
: At least it isn’t made of magpies.
: In a sense, I think it is. And, in a different sense, I probably should be stepping aside right now to prevent my own mental decline.

: But unfortunately, being by your side somehow trumps the prospect of crying myself to sleep later when you abandon me for your childhood friend. So I guess I’ll just stand around and wait for the suffering to begin.
: I’m sorry, Maya.
scene skitwar9
: You’re sorry? After we’re finally starting to patch things up, you’re sorry?
: About which part, Sensei? Casting me to the wayside the first opportunity you got? Or the fact that I had to find out from fucking Instagram?
: Which I don’t even like, by the way. I only made one so I could stalk your stupid childhood friend who I am absolutely jealous of but still hate with a fiery passion.
: Thank you for your honesty at least.
scene skitwar10
: Don’t thank me for it. Just pay me back with your own.
: What happened to trying? To seeing me as me and not the version you lost? We both love you the same. And I bet you’d have chosen her over Niki, wouldn’t you? So why not me?
: How come every single time I think things are going to change for the better, some cruel twist of fate shows up to drag me back to the sad reality that is falling for someone twice your age?
scene skitwar11
: I’m not avoiding you this time, don’t worry. And I’m not going to hide you from Niki either if that’s what you’re worried about.
: I don’t care about the hiding part. I grew up hiding because of the nature of our relationship. I will hide all fucking day if that’s what you want from me.
: I just don’t want you conflicted. And I want to feel like your heart is mine to destroy instead of hers since that’s been my biggest fear all along.
scene skitwar12
: The only person allowed to destroy my heart is me. And I will be damned if I don’t do it every single chance I get.
: I remembered something yesterday. Just...randomly. And I lost the fucking drawing competition because of it. Me. Drawing. Of all fucking things. And to Yasu, of all people.
: I didn’t even realize you could draw.
: You know I can draw. Your brain is just shit from years worth of being sodomized by Father Time. But my memory was of a talk we had.
: Where I specifically told you that this day would come. That Niki would waltz back into your life and you’d stop caring about me.

: Now, that is happening and I am scared. And I will not lie about being scared because I want you to help me feel safe. And if you don’t, I’m probably just going to turn into another Ami or something.
: That’s the single worst threat a person can make to me.
scene skitwar13
: Then look me in the eyes and say you’ll do all you can to prevent it. That you love me. And will continue to love me even when that girl says you’re not allowed to.
: Maya...there is nothing or no one in this world that is going to stop me from loving you. Okay? My life with Niki is entirely different from my life with you.
scene skitwar14
: Feel better?
: A little...
: I still feel expendable, though. And I wish sometimes that you’d just lock me in some secret room again so I wouldn’t have to watch from the windows as you torch the world I’ve come to love.
: This world was on fire long before you and I were a part of it.
: Unless I made it, you mean...
scene skitwar15
: ...Yeah.
: Unless you made it.
: Do you think I could destroy it too if that’s really the case?
: Do you want to?
: Sometimes.
: I’ll want to less if you just...stop making me mad, though.
: I’m going to keep making you mad so long as we both exist here.
: Then don’t hold it against me if we just stop existing one day.
: I turn my body into the sun!
scene skitwar16
: From the sun, Miku. Ahab does not become the sun.
: Silence, whale! For you will soon taste the sting of my blade after doing all of those very bad things you did! What a ho Tashtego is! Let me have a hammer!
: Hah...Oh no, Captain Ahab. Please turn your harpoons away from my whale-ish body. I am not yet prepared to be...penetrated so violently by your many men on this tragic day.
: Oh! Yet three unsurrendered pirates of mine, a cracked heel, and God keeps bullying the hull! Why must you be so firm and naughty?!
: I am going to kill myself tonight.
scene skitwar17
: Pointy pole prow! Glorious death-ship! Must ye then perish? And without me?!
scene skitwar18
: Am I cut off from the last fondue for the meanest shipwrecked captains?! Oh, lonely death! Oh, lonely life!
scene skitwar19
: I am a whale. Fear me. Ahab must die.
: Would it kill ya to be a little more enthusiastic? We’re friggin’ acting here, Makoto!
: I AM A WHALE. FEAR ME. AHAB MUST DIE.
scene skitwar20
: That’s more like it! And now I feel my topside greatness lie on top of my grief! Ho, ho, ho! From all your furthest boundaries, I’ll pour you a drink and comb your hair! Then die!
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
: Towards thee, I roll! You big, stupid whale! To the last, I grapple with thee! From hell’s heart, I stab at thee! For hate’s sake, I spit my last breath at thee!
scene skitwar21
: Sink your damn coffins are horses into the pool. And since neither can be mine, let me tear them into pieces while chasing thee! Tied to thee, you stupid whale!
: I AM SOMEHOW VICTORIOUS. WHALES RULE AND HUMANS SUCK.
: And thus...
scene skitwar22
: I give up my spear...
: That’s a sword.
scene skitwar23
: Done! That went better than I thought it would.
scene skitwar24
: Imani.
: Please don’t tell me I have failed her as a teacher.
: You have failed this girl as a teacher. Not only was 80%% of that monologue incorrect, the incorrect parts didn’t even make sense.
: In Miss Imai’s defense, Miku is beyond help.
: You ain’t much further behind, Ami. Least outside of writing.
scene skitwar25
: There’s no shame in having a specialty. I just put all of my effort toward that instead of math and history since that stuff won’t really matter in the grand scheme of things.
: The whole world is sort of built upon those things, though.
: And yet, you deliver this message with words and not numbers or the names of presidents.
: Have you still been writing lately, Arakawa Jr.? I’m interested in seeing more of your work if you feel like sharing any of it.
: Oh, that wouldn’t be appropriate. My recent work would tarnish your image of me. It’s far too raw and sexual.
: Never again do I want to hear those words come out of your mouth. Got it?
scene skitwar26
: Now, wait one moment. There’s nothing wrong with exploring such themes at Arakawa Jr.’s age.
: Poetry for girls like us is but one form of expression. And it’s better she gets those feelings out in an artistic way rather than a destructive one that bleeds into reality.
: Yeah, because artistry never bleeds into reality.
: That’s not what I said. I just think there’s no crime being committed here.
: And that, if there was, it’d be wrong of you to turn a blind eye to your beloved Fukuyama who, last I heard, spends a great deal of her free time writing smut in the school library.
scene skitwar27
: Woah, hold on! We ain’t engaging in some war of our own where we’ve gotta choose a girl, are we? I ain’t favoring Futaba. She shouldn’t be writing that stuff in school either.
: Miss Watabe likes me now since I told her she should be my new mom.
: Bitch, I’m right here.
: Don’t call your students “bitch.”
: That word’s empowering now, though.
: Not when used in a derogatory fashion.
scene skitwar28
: Also, this has nothing to do with your comments regarding the nature of motherhood and me.
: And even if there are things that have made me question such principles as of late, I am not willing to bend on this aspect of my character.
: I can bend. I’m pretty flexible.
: But would I be allowed to say things like “raw” and “sexual” around you?
: I’d really prefer you didn’t.
: Yeah, I don’t think it’s going to work then.
scene skitwar29
: What, shall this speech be spoke for our excuse? Or shall we on without apology?
: The date is out of such prolixity. We’ll have no Cupid hoodwinked with a scarf, bearing a Tartar’s painted bow of lath, scaring the ladies like a crowkeeper.
: Nor no without-book prologue, faintly spoke after the prompter, for our entrance. But let them measure us by what they will. We’ll measure them a measure and be gone.
: Give me a torch. I am not for this ambling. Being but heavy, I will bear the light.
scene skitwar30
: Nay, gentle Romeo, we must have you dance.
: Not I, believe me. You have dancing shoes with nimble soles. I have a soul of lead so stakes me to the ground I cannot move.
: You are a lover. Borrow Cupid’s wings and soar with them above a common bound.
: I am too sore enpiercèd with his shaft to soar with his light feathers, and so bound I cannot bound a pitch above dull woe. Under love’s heavy burden do I sink.
: And to sink in it should you burden love — Too great oppression for a tender thing.
: Is love a tender thing? It is too rough, too rude, too boist’rous, and it pricks like thorn.
: If love be rough with you, be rough with love. Prick love for pricking, and you beat love down.
: Give me a case to put my visage in — A visor for a visor. What care I what curious eye doth cote deformities? Here are the beetle brows shall blush for me.
scene skitwar31
: Wakana...this ain’t what I think it is, is it?
: Romeo and Juliet — Act 1, Scene 4.
: This bitch ain’t gonna do the fuckin’ Queen Mab monologue, is she?
: Again with the “bitch” thing.
: Queen Mab?
scene skitwar32
: It’s a scene in which Romeo’s good friend, Mercutio, mocks Romeo for believing in his dreams of love.
: Does Mercutio not believe in love?

: He is a cynic. So it’s less that he doesn’t believe in love as a concept, but more that those who dream of it and pursue said dreams are blind to the chaos and irrationality they may potentially breed in doing so.
scene skitwar33
: It’s an excellent monologue, really. Perhaps the best in the entire play.
: But it can be quite difficult to capture Mercutio’s brand of sarcastic whimsy, so someone inexperienced attempting it could potentially be quite terrible, all things considered.
: You say that, but Tsuneyo seems pretty locked in right now.
scene skitwar34
: I mean, sir, in delay, we waste our lights; in vain, light lights by day. Take our good meaning, for our judgment sits five times in that ere once in our five wits.
: And...And we mean well in going to this masque, but ’tis no wit to go.
: Why, may one ask?
: I dreamt a dream tonight.
: And so did I.
: Well...what was yours?
scene skitwar35
: That dreamers often lie.
: In bed asleep while they do dream things true.
: Ahh...then I see Queen Mab hath been with you.
: Q...Queen Mab?
: She is...the fairies’ midwife.
scene skitwar36
: And she comes in shape no bigger than an agate stone on the forefinger of an alderman...drawn with a team of little atomi over men’s noses as they lie asleep.
: Her wagon spokes made of long spinners’ legs, the cover of the wings of grasshoppers, her traces of the smallest spider web, her collars of the moonshine’s wat’ry beams...
scene skitwar37
: Her whip of cricket’s bone, the lash of film, her wagoner a small gray-coated gnat, not half so big as a round little worm pricked from the lazy finger of a maid.

: Her chariot is an empty hazelnut, made by the joiner squirrel or old grub, time out o’ mind the fairies’ coachmakers. And in this state she gallops night by night through lovers’ brains, and then they dream of love.
scene skitwar38
: On courtiers’ knees, that dream on cur’sies straight; O’er lawyers’ fingers, who straight dream on fees; O’er ladies’ lips, who straight on kisses dream...
: Which oft the angry Mab with blisters plagues because their breaths with sweetmeats tainted are.
scene skitwar39
: Sometime she gallops o’er a courtier’s nose, and then dreams he of smelling out a suit.
: And sometime comes she with a tithe-pig’s tail, tickling a parson’s nose as he lies asleep...then he dreams of another benefice.
scene skitwar40
: Sometime she driveth o’er a soldier’s neck, and then dreams he of cutting foreign throats!

: Of breaches! Ambuscadoes! Spanish blades! Of healths five fathom deep! And then anon drums in his ear, at which he starts and wakes and, being thus frighted, swears a prayer or two and sleeps again.
scene skitwar41
: This is that very Mab...that plats the manes of horses in the night and bakes the elflocks in foul sluttish hairs, which once untangled much misfortune bodes.
: This is the hag, when maids lie on their backs, that presses them and learns them first to bear, making them women of good carriage...
: This is she.
: Peace...Peace, Mercutio, peace.
: Thou talk’st of nothing.
: True, I talk of dreams...which are the children of an idle brain, begot of nothing but vain fantasy, which is as thin of substance as the air and more inconstant than the wind...
: Who woos even now the frozen bosom of the north and, being angered, puffs away from thence, turning his side to the dew-dropping south...
scene skitwar42
: Oh my god. I had no idea you had such a good actress in your class, Sana.
: Neither did I. I always figured I was the best until literally right now.
: She’s not usually like that either, is she? I’ve seen her before. She’s normally all...quiet and mild-mannered, right? So tall too.
: Do you have a crush on her now or something?
: Is she old enough for me to have a crush on her?
: I don’t think so, no.
: Then no. I definitely don’t have a crush on her.
scene skitwar43
: Hey. Sorry, I’m late. Got stuck in class for longer than I thought and-
: Bye.
scene skitwar44
: Oh.
: She’s a big fan of yours. Probably just super nervous around you given how beautiful you are.
: You’re fucking her too, aren’t you?
: Leave this one alone if you can. She’s a little different from-
scene skitwar45
: Nope! Be right back! Time to break another one before everyone realizes I’m here and I get distracted and won’t be able to make her feel inferior until way later!
: She already does, though. So please, as a favor to me-
: Aww, look at you thinking you’re in the position to ask me for favors. Stay right here and don’t get sucked into any weird sex with teenagers without me.
: Are you...saying you want to be included?
: Only if we are bathing in their blood.
scene skitwar46
: ...What?
: Sensei! Come over here and- woah. Was that just-
: No. Niki isn’t here yet.
: But I just-
scene skitwar47
: I’m here, though. What do you need?
: Help choosing a winner.
: Really? Was it not obvious?
: I’m too nice to pick on my own and break one of their hearts.
: So you’re letting me do it instead?
: Pretty much, yeah.
: Wow. Well, thanks. I definitely don’t hurt people enough as is. Having this added opportunity to do so makes me feel a lot better.
: Seems only fair that you get to weigh in on a contest for your body, Sensei. Just give it to me straight. Not all curved like those weird amateur porno dicks.
: She’s not usually like this, Sara.
: The heck are you talkin’ about? Yes I am.
: She works with Maki now. I get it.
: I am ready for my victory now. Please give it to me hard and straight as well so I can feel it deep inside.
: She’s not usually like this either.
: He is correct this time. I may be the most beautiful and mature person in this room, but I have still never gone to Virginia.
Well...looks like the time has come to choose a winner.
And this time, the answer has to be...

scene skitwar48
: What?
: What?
: This is clearly racism.
: You’re half Japanese.
: And you’re half racist.
: Are you...absolutely sure that’s who you think should win? Is there something missing here?
: I bet Makoto’s involved again. She bought a point in the first round and I wouldn’t put it past her to buy another for me in the last round.
: No bribes were involved. I’m just giving you more points than I probably should for putting a creative spin on a classic speech.

: Tsuneyo was a better actor, don’t get me wrong. But that scene’s been done so many times before and, if we’re judging this contest based on the skit as a whole, Miku’s was just more entertaining to me.
: I see. So my efforts go unnoticed once more and the father of my son continues to avoid ever making me feel as if I’ve done a good job.
scene skitwar49
: The what now? You have a son?
: Not for much longer at this rate.

: I don’t really care how it looks. If Sara doesn’t like my choice, she can overrule me or whatever. But if I’m allowed to pick, you’re the one I choose.
: And it’s definitely not just to make Tsuneyo mad either.
: If I had brought my sword, there would be two halves of you we’d need to collect votes from.

scene skitwar55
: Hi. Do you think you could spare a minute of your time to talk about our lord and savior, Jesus Christ?
: Not really, no.
: Then how about an hour or two with a cute and fun-sized girl bouncing on top of your penis while everybody else wonders where you went?
: That’s more my speed. But Niki’s outside ruining another girl’s life right now and I’m pretty sure she specifically mentioned not getting sucked into any weird sex with teenagers while she’s gone.
: Okay. So let’s just not make it weird then.
: Two hours is still a long time, Sana.
: I heard you did it with Noriko for five. And that was with her sister walking in on it.
scene skitwar56
: True. But the months that immediately followed were pretty terrible for me and I’ve only just now managed to claw my way back to a good place.
: Imagine she joined in?
scene skitwar57
: What?
: With you and Noriko...You would have been super into that, right?
: Well, obviously. They’re both extremely attractive and good at sex. But it’s not like they’d actually want that and that takes a lot of the fun out of it.
: But if they did want to, you would do it?
: What are you getting at?
: Just satisfying my own curiosity. Will you come with me or not?
: No.
: Wrong answer. Yes you will. Because I have a surprise for you and now you won’t be able to stop thinking about it until you find out.
: It’s not lingerie, is it?
: Nope. But asking for hints won’t get you anywhere at all. It’s something you sort of have to see in order to believe.
: And how long will seeing this take, exactly? Because we both know it won’t be as simple as just that.

: As short or as long as you want. I feel like you won’t ever want to leave, though. But the good news is you won’t ever have to. Because this is a present meant to last a lifetime. Maybe even longer?
: Longer than a lifetime? Do you know something you shouldn’t, Sana?
: I know lots of things. But what I know most of all is how sad you’d be if you found out what you missed tonight.
: Then why not just tell me about it?
: Because I also know you wouldn’t come if I did. It’s a very fragile situation, [sanamaster]. And it would really be best if you were to just come with me.
: I...probably shouldn’t.
: No, you probably shouldn’t.
